notes.title: Patchnotes v0.0.0.9
notes.content:
The save system has been completely redesigned. Old saves are available for loading in Menu-> Load Game-> Old Saves.
A warehouse for carcasses has been added, it has a limit of 25 simultaneously stored carcasses.
Hunters will now transfer their loot to this warehouse if there is free space in it.


The next patch will finally add new starting islands with different climatic conditions, new animals, the ability to build a boat and go on expeditions to other islands.

notes.title: Changelog v0.0.0.6
notes.content:
The tutorial has been completely revised. Now he explains a little better how exactly, according to the developer, to play correctly. Plus, he's now with small videos.

The interface is starting to change a little - some text buttons have been replaced with icons.
After loading, carcasses should no longer turn into dummies.
The killed animals stopped twitching after death.
Beds marked as medical now have a visual distinction.
Fixed a bug with outfitting clothes
Now, having chosen the layout of the building, you will immediately see how many materials are still missing to start construction.
The names of the animals have been translated.
Changed the format of random names for tamed animals.
The format of the name of the saves has been changed.
Fixed a bug due to which the skills of doctors and researchers increased incorrectly.
Added a new type of fabric. Now it will be easier to sew summer clothes.
The weather is saved after loading.
When preparing dishes that require vegetables, ingredients such as apples, pears, berries and bananas will be used as a last resort, since they are not really vegetables.

The next patch is scheduled for the weekend, unless I broke something important, which will again have to stay up all night to release an urgent patch.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.0.0.4
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]
The gardens have been repaired again.
Fixed incorrect animal models on the cutting table.
The settlers have come to terms with their situation and will not try to drown themselves in the sea.
Cases of getting stuck in rocks will now be much less common.
The duration of the night, as well as the sleep of the settlers, has been further reduced.
The number of creeping interface elements in some locations has been reduced.
Added a couple of new animations and sounds.
Increased lighting level in case of strong clouds.
Something must have broken.


[h3]Now that the worst bugs have been fixed, I can start to improve the gameplay. In the next patches, it is planned to add:[/h3]
-new island
-storage for carcasses so that hunters can bring prey
-adding new species of animals to fill the warehouse for carcasses
-new animations and sounds so that chefs and doctors do not have to do their job swinging a hammer
-improve the tutorial
-movement of furniture
-balance changes
-the settlers will try to fall asleep near the fire
-the settlers will have to climb the tables less often
-the roadmap will be published
-achievements will be added

notes.title: Small changelog
notes.content:
Hello and Happy New Year.
I was sick for a while, so there was no one to compile and publish the changelog.

Here's a list of changes starting around September. Some points were introduced at the time when the demo was publicly available, some were made later.

[list]
[*]added the ability to save and load the current game progress

[*]added various weather effects: snow in winter, rain in spring, autumn and sometimes in summer, with and without lightning (depending on the location of the settlement), dust storms in summer (not in all climatic zones).

[*]now settlers are more actively influenced by the temperature regime, they can catch a cold or even suffer from frostbite in winter or get heatstroke in summer, if they do not get clothes for the season and home

[*]In addition to being able to get sick, settlers can now lose limbs during or after combat. Doctors will be able to supply you with a wooden replacement. Unfortunately, the work on the character models is not finished yet, and this will only be displayed in the status window, not on the settler

[*]added the ability to grow your crop, but not in all climatic zones

[*]now animals can be tamed. Some animals will help you in battle, some will bring resources, and all the rest can be eaten

[*]lightning strike can now set fire to your buildings

[/list]
Added a lot of new bugs
Fixed bug with deviation of game time after loading the game
Fixed another bug with navigation in houses, now settlers will even less often try to sit at the table in the house through the wall and throw materials through the window



At the moment, work is underway on the following tasks:

- automatic irrigation
- fishing
- balloon for terrain reconnaissance
- boat for traveling to neighboring islands
- research and development

[*]In addition to being able to get sick, settlers can now lose limbs during or after combat. Doctors will be able to supply you with a wooden replacement.
[*]added the ability to grow your crop, but not in all climatic zones
[*]now animals can be tamed.

notes.title: Patch notes V0.0.0.2
notes.content:
Crafting system changed:
Recurring tasks grouped together
Now, during production, when resources are scarce, subsequent tasks are checked and activated
The selected building window displays the progress of the current work

Increased maximum camera range
Fixed typos
The cursor now slightly illuminates the area at night
Added descriptions to some stats
Changed the material of buildings under construction, now small details will be better visible
Changed the turn step of the building during construction
Decreased eyeadaptation strength
Fixed getting stuck in the river
A new resource has been added to the map - hard stone
Some buildings will now have a visible mark during construction, which allows you to more accurately deploy the building
Added a filter for trees and food in the task of collecting resources
Recipes now display information about the amount of resources produced and the required amount of work
When built, the lights will turn on immediately
Fixed a bug with mass equipping equipment
Some buildings now have different work efficiency
Fixed a (possibly) navigation bug that caused NPCs to get stuck in trees

Saves and logs will be added in the next patch
